question: How should partless awareness be understood in the present context?
premises: In the earlier discussion, partless awareness was approached through aspects such as qualities, parts, and wholes.
The same method can be applied in the present case.
The teaching aims at recognition of partless being.
inference: Just as partless awareness was understood earlier through differentiated aspects, it should be understood in the same way here.
uncertainties: The compressed compound niraṃśabhāvasaṃbodha may emphasize either realization or conceptual understanding.
plain_english: Therefore, just as in the earlier discussion awareness of the partless reality was understood through aspects such as qualities, parts, and wholes, so too it should be understood here.
